reasoning_traces.think:
The core operator is a directed graph with reversed arcs to attribute playmaking credit. Each pass from player i to j becomes an arc from j to i in the graph, enabling PageRank to compute influence flow toward playmakers. The goal node acts as sink for scoring events, ensuring all paths terminate. This structure allows for a stationary distribution over players' influence, which is then scaled into an interpretable IPM score. The model assumes equal weight for all passes and uses primitivity scaffolding to ensure unique solutions. Dualities arise in how the same event can be interpreted as either a pass or a turnover depending on direction. Failure modes include disconnected components, equal arc weights leading to misrepresentation of pass value, and arbitrary scaffolding arcs affecting rankings. The model is descriptive only, lacking predictive capability but offering insight into hidden playmaking dynamics missed by traditional box scores.
